types.name: Types and properties of numbers
types.description: Asks which number is prime, rational, even or odd, or which statement about a kind of number (prime, co-prime, integer, whole) is true.

types.name: Is it divisible?
types.description: Gives a fully written number and asks which divisor (such as 7, 8, 11, 72, 88 or 99) divides it exactly.

types.name: Find the missing digit
types.description: A number has a missing digit shown as x or * and the question asks which digit makes it divisible by a given number.

types.name: Largest or smallest number divisible by d
types.description: Asks for the largest or smallest n-digit number, or the number nearest to a given value, that is exactly divisible by a given number, or what to add or subtract to make it so.

types.name: Unit digit of a power or product
types.description: Asks for the last (unit) digit of a large power, product or sum of powers.

types.name: Remainders
types.description: Asks for the remainder when a number, an expression in n, or a large power is divided by some number.

types.name: Number, sum and product of factors
types.description: Asks how many factors (divisors) a number has, how many are odd, even or perfect squares, or their sum or product.

types.name: Trailing zeros and powers in a factorial
types.description: Asks how many zeros are at the end of a factorial or product, or the highest power of a prime that divides a factorial.

types.name: Counting numbers in a range
types.description: Asks how many numbers between two limits are divisible, or not divisible, by one or more given numbers.

types.name: Recurring decimals as fractions
types.description: Asks to write a recurring (repeating) decimal such as 0.121212... as a fraction, or to add recurring decimals.

types.name: Consecutive numbers and series sums
types.description: Involves consecutive integers, even or odd numbers, or the sum of a series such as 1 + 2 + ... + n or squares and cubes.
